summary: The RailSymbol icon export is marked @deprecated (a brand icon slated for removal in v1), where before it carried no deprecation tag
The chrome icon is renamed chromium: Chromium is the canonical export and Chrome remains only as an alias of it (both tagged @deprecated as brand icons)

The fingerprint icon is renamed fingerprint-pattern and the notes mark the import change breaking: FingerprintPattern is the new export, the Fingerprint named export survives only as an alias, and the per-icon module dist/esm/icons/fingerprint.js is no longer published (the dynamic-icon name 'fingerprint' still resolves)

flip-horizontal and flip-vertical are renamed square-centerline-dashed-horizontal and square-centerline-dashed-vertical; FlipHorizontal and FlipVertical remain as aliases of the new SquareCenterlineDashedHorizontal/Vertical exports

All brand icons are removed: the exports Chrome, Chromium, Codepen, Codesandbox, Dribbble, Facebook, Figma, Framer, Github, Gitlab, Instagram, Linkedin, Pocket, RailSymbol, Slack, Trello, Twitch, Twitter and Youtube (with their *Icon/Lucide* variants, icon modules and dynamic-icon names) no longer exist, where 0.x still shipped them as deprecated exports
The UMD bundle is dropped: dist/umd/lucide-react.js and lucide-react.min.js (the main:umd and unpkg entries) are no longer published, leaving only the ESM and CJS builds
The text-select icon is renamed square-dashed-text: SquareDashedText is the canonical export and TextSelect (like the older TextSelection) remains only as an alias of it

The ESM build switches from .js to .mjs files: the module entry is dist/esm/lucide-react.mjs and per-icon modules are dist/esm/icons/<name>.mjs, so deep imports of the former dist/esm/*.js paths no longer resolve (CJS paths are unchanged)
The podcast icon is replaced by the new mic-signal and mic-audio-lines icons: Podcast remains only as an alias of MicSignal and now renders the mic-signal artwork instead of the old podcast design

The emoticon icons are redrawn and renamed after their Unicode emoji: angry→face-angry, annoyed→face-expressionless, laugh→face-grinning, meh→face-neutral, frown→face-slightly-frowning, smile→face-slightly-smiling; Angry, Annoyed, Laugh, Meh, Frown and Smile remain as aliases of the new exports

The trash icon's own design is removed in favour of trash-2: the Trash export now renders the former trash-2 artwork and Trash2 remains only as an alias of Trash (its metadata marks the alias deprecated), where before they were two different icons
SwissFranc, BadgeSwissFranc and ReceiptSwissFranc are marked @deprecated (the depicted symbol is obsolete), where before they carried no deprecation tag

The absoluteStrokeWidth prop (on icon components and LucideProvider) is marked @deprecated in favour of the new nonScalingStroke prop, which sets vector-effect=non-scaling-stroke on the paths instead of rescaling stroke-width
The exported IconNode type is marked @deprecated in favour of LucideIconNode[] (and the new LucideIconData object type); IconNode's element names widen from an SVG tag-name union to string

Per-icon ESM modules (lucide-react/dist/esm/icons/<name>.mjs; the CJS build is a single bundle) export __iconData, an object {name, size, node}, instead of the bare __iconNode node array; __iconNode is only declared (as deprecated) in the types and is no longer exported at runtime, and DynamicIconModule now reads __iconData

flip-horizontal-2 and flip-vertical-2 are renamed triangles-centerline-dashed-horizontal and triangles-centerline-dashed-vertical; FlipHorizontal2 and FlipVertical2 remain as aliases of the new TrianglesCenterlineDashedHorizontal/Vertical exports
